asset_set: Questionnaire Q14 option 1 — Teaching coding to kids

art_style.fill_technique: solid flat fills with optional 8–12% ambient shade on curved surfaces only
art_style.shading: single cel shadow ellipse under laptop and forearms — no cast shadows on transparent edge
art_style.texture: none on skin; subtle sticker-paper edge suggestion on star reward via 3 parallel lines max
art_style.mood: warm mentoring energy — approachable classroom moment, not a formal lecture hall
reference_vibe: KursoKo approved RIASEC sticker line weight
art_style.match_family: Same 2px ink and flat fill language as RIASEC stickers — but NO letter glyph and NO colored border frame
forbidden: die-cut sticker border or white card frame

accent.name: lavender
accent.use: code-block shapes on screen, mentor cardigan trim

secondary.name: KursoKo teal
secondary.use: second code-block color, star sticker outline

skin.tone: warm neutral medium (adult); lighter warm tone at smaller scale (child)
skin.note: flat fill, no blush gradient; two skin scales to show adult-child pairing

color.background: fully transparent — no floor plane, no vignette, no cream fill behind scene
color.lighting_tint: faint warm #FFF8F0 highlight on knuckle tops only
color.accent_rule: lavender appears on 2–3 small areas max — not a background wash

lighting.highlight: small curved highlights on laptop lid edge and star sticker
lighting.shadow: flat #2D2D2D at 12% opacity under hands and laptop base

pose.camera_distance: medium-close — hands occupy lower 55% of frame

left_hand.action: gently guides a smaller hand toward the trackpad
left_hand.grip: open supportive hover, fingertips barely touching the child's hand
left_hand.position: lower-left quadrant, wrist angled toward center

right_hand.action: a smaller child-scale hand clicks a colorful code block
right_hand.grip: single-finger tap on the block shape
right_hand.position: center-right, resting on the laptop trackpad

pose.gesture_summary: mid-lesson freeze frame — a guided click that completes a code block
pose.framing: crop at mid-forearm — no elbows, no face, no torso

accessories.placement: stuck to the desk beside the laptop, not on skin

subject.scene_narrative: An adult forearm gently guides a smaller child-scale hand toward a laptop trackpad, where a colorful block-based coding screen glows with simple lavender and yellow shapes. A teal star sticker rewards progress on the desk. The moment captures patient, playful mentorship — a first coding win, not a formal classroom lecture.

primary_objects.name: laptop with block-code colors
primary_objects.detail: screen shows stacked colorful block shapes snapping together, no readable text

primary_objects.name: child-scale hand
primary_objects.size_relative: small — nested beside the adult hand
primary_objects.detail: index finger extended, mid-tap on a lavender code block

primary_objects.name: star sticker reward
primary_objects.detail: simple five-point star, 2px outline, resting on the desk

subject.environment: light classroom table surface strip across bottom third — fades to transparent at edges

composition.layout: converging guidance line from adult hand to child hand at the trackpad
composition.negative_space: transparent margin top and sides — 48px safe zone for card crop
depth_layers: background: table edge only — no wall
composition.thumbnail_readability: laptop silhouette + two differently sized hand shapes readable at 160px width

generation.negative_prompt: face, portrait, person head, text, watermark, logo, coding platform brand, letter S, border frame, sticker outline, photorealistic, 3d render, cgi, blurry, dark background, formal lecture hall, guns, blood

prompt_for_image_ai: Flat vector illustration, 640x640, transparent PNG background. KursoKo quiz choice for "Teaching coding to kids". Style: flat vector, 2px dark outline #2D2D2D, solid fills, minimal cel shadow under hands — matches KursoKo RIASEC sticker family, NO letter, NO border frame, NO text on image. Scene: an adult forearm gently guides a smaller child-scale hand toward a laptop trackpad on a classroom table. The screen shows stacked block-code shapes in lavender #9575CD and yellow #FFD54F, no readable text. A teal #4DB6AC star sticker rests on the desk beside it. Soft steel-blue cardigan sleeve rolled to mid-forearm with lavender cuff trim. Warm medium skin tones #C8956C (adult) and lighter #D9A876 (child). Three-quarter top-down camera, hands in lower half. Mood: patient, playful mentorship.
